meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把口播或访谈视频加上随字幕同步的图形卡片,原片画面保持不动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有口播或访谈素材,想加同步图形卡但不想动原画面。
copy.tagline_en: Add transcript-synced graphic cards to your talking-head video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have talking-head footage and want graphic cards fast

howto.what: 给它一段本地的口播、访谈或播客视频，它会读转录稿，把标题、下三分、数据标注、引用、侧栏、画中画等图形卡片按说话时间排好，写出卡片 HTML 并合成渲染成 MP4；原片画面不动。
howto.when: 当你提到 “graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics” 等关键词，或要求给现有的口播/访谈视频加图形包装时触发；只加普通字幕请用 embedded-captions。

say.text: 给这段口播视频加上图形卡片包装，做成 9:16。
say.note: 会先转录音频，再设计卡片

say.text: 把这段访谈剪成 4:5，配上标题和下三分卡片。
这段播客信息密度高，图形卡片多排一些。
say.note: 卡片数量按时长和密度算

howto.what_en: Point it at a local talking-head, interview or podcast clip: it reads the transcript, writes timed graphic card HTML (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, PiP), assembles a composition and renders MP4. The clip plays untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", or ask to package an existing talking-head clip with designed graphic cards. Plain subtitles belong to embedded-captions.

say_en.text: Package this talking-head clip with graphic cards, 9:16.
say_en.note: It transcribes the audio first, then designs the cards.

say_en.text: Recut this interview to 4:5 with title and lower-third cards.
This podcast is dense, make more graphic cards.
say_en.note: Card count follows duration and density.
